skill_name: Given some facts, provide a comprehensive analysis of the situation.
workflow: The survey reveals that a majority of people disagree with the new regulations restricting access to the river. This indicates that local support for the regulation is quite low. It is likely that the regulations have been viewed as an unnecessary and oppressive measure by the local population. Furthermore, the survey results suggest that the local population perceives the regulations as a violation of their rights and freedom, as well as a potential violation of their traditional ways of life.
